text: seems to only do vertical rows. is that true?
resolution: Diagnosed Align Loop's apparent vertical-only behavior. The implementation chooses the globally smallest X/Y/Z coordinate span, including axes whose span is already zero because a selected row lies on a planar surface. It then rejects that zero-span axis as already flat, so a horizontal planar row never reaches its small nonzero vertical span. The only regression fixture is a non-planar four-vertex ring with nonzero span on all three axes, which cannot expose this failure. No source change was made because the user asked whether the limitation was real; the required correction is an orientation-aware axis choice that excludes the surface-normal flatness without losing repeat-operation idempotence.
